title: Pricing
subtitle: One platform for your pipelines — in the studio and inside the AI apps you already use.
betaFree: Free during beta — no card is taken. The price starts at paid launch.
checkoutDisabled: Checkout opens when billing goes live
billingNote: The payment gateway is not connected yet, so this page cannot take payment. Nothing is charged and no subscription is created today.

monthly.title: One flat monthly subscription
monthly.body: A single per-account fee covers every feature — no seat counts and no plan levels.

trial.title: 7-day trial from signup
trial.body: Every account starts on a 7-day trial counted from the moment it signs up.

byok.title: Bring your own model keys
byok.body: Add your own LLM provider keys in Settings and pay those providers directly.

noPerRun.title: No per-run fees
noPerRun.body: We never meter a run: each provider call is billed by your own provider.

solo.name: DeeWaanAI
solo.feature2: Up to 3 LLM providers per pipeline
solo.feature4: Companion MCP: run pipelines from Claude, ChatGPT, Qwen Code & Kimi

marketplace.title: Certified pipelines, sold once
marketplace.body: Buy a pipeline on the Marketplace and run it from any connected AI app — every listing is published with its full test record: the exact judging prompts, every score and every failure.
